root.label: Subacute Multisystem Skin Lesions with Inflammatory and Allergic Features
supporting_facts: Erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions on face, chest, abdomen, and limbs
Mycological culture yielded growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate, C-reactive protein, and white blood cell count
excluded_candidates: Bacterial infection: less likely due to mycological culture results
Autoimmune disorder: possible but less likely due to presence of Trichophyton mentagrophytes
Allergic reaction: possible but less likely due to presence of Trichophyton mentagrophytes
